book.name: Amǝ Roma
book.title: Cauterǝa mala Bulǝs aban ká a ban AMƏ ROMA

content: Túró mala amǝkwaɗi abanƁakuli andǝ aɓwana

Ace mani ka, wun amǝ'eambǝam, ǝn nggǝ ɓuakia rǝ wun, nǝ ɓwamuru mala Ɓakuli, wu pa rǝwun aban Ɓakuli, kǝla gìr'nkila mǝyilǝmui, mǝnana wun nǝ̀ duk amale, sǝ nǝ̀ pwasǝbumi ka. Mǝnia ka nda peri ma'wun mǝɓafoe a baní.

Wu kǝa kpata ɓealu andǝ kúncau mala mǝnia yì ɓanza ka ɗàng. Wu ɗeki Ɓakuli ɓǝ̀ nggaɗi wun nǝ tsǝk ɗenyicau ma'wun ɓǝ̀ duk bǝshe. Anggo sǝ wun nǝ̀ gandǝ súrǝ̀ nê mala Ɓakuli, mǝnana mǝɓoarne na, andǝ mǝnana nǝ̀ duk gir'a a baní, sǝ nda pepè ka.

Nǝ ɓwamuru mǝnana à pam ngga, ǝn nggǝ banggi koyan atà wun ngga, ɓǝ̀ kǝa twal ɓamúrì kǝ̀rkǝ́r ɓǝ̀ kútì bancame male ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ ɗenyicau mala koya ɓwa ka, ɓǝ̀ karǝ arǝ paɓamuru male mǝnana Ɓakuli pe wi ka.
Kǝla mǝnana nggùnrǝu ka abare nda pas, sǝ koya bare ka túró male nda ɗàng ngga,
anggo, aɓa Kǝrǝsti ka, sǝm mǝnana sǝm nda pas ka, sǝm dumǝna nggūrǝu mwashat, sǝ sǝm nda ace rǝarǝ sǝm.
Sǝm ndanǝ aɓoro ɗàngɗáng aɓa ɓwamuru mǝnana Ɓakuli pa sǝm ngga. Ɓǝ̀ mò yì ɓoro nda na gì Ɓakuli ka, pè a njarì mǝnana karǝ arǝ paɓamuru mò ka.
Ɓǝ̀ pakkia aɓwana túró nda mò yì ɓoro ka, wú kǝ pê aɓa mǝsǝcau. Ɓǝ̀ mò ka kanigir na ka, wú kǝ kania aɓwana gìr.

Ɓǝ̀ mò ka ɓakɓabum aɓwana na ka, wú kǝ pak túró ɓakɓabum. Ɓǝ̀ pàbù nda mò yì ɓoro ka, wú kǝ pê nǝ ɓabumo mwashat. Ɓǝ̀ mò ka túró lidǝmba nǝ aɓwana na ka, wú kǝ pê nǝ ɓabumpina. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ lǝmdǝ ɓwamuru nda mò ka, wú kǝ lǝmdǝí nǝ banɓoarnado.
Do mala mǝkpata Ɓakuliaɓa earcearǝu
Earcearǝu ka, ɓǝà pè nǝ mǝsǝcau. Wu ginǝki ɓealɓikea, sǝ wu bwal gìr mǝnana mǝɓoarne na ka kàngkàng.
Wu earce rǝarǝ wun nǝ earceban mǝ'mǝsǝcau nì. Ɓǝ̀ ban ɓoara wun arǝ pe rǝarǝ wun gulo.
Ce wu duk amǝnkundǝr, amǝ'ɗwanyi rǝɓǝla arǝ túró ɗang, wu duk amǝ bumpina aɓa pakki Mǝtalabangŋo túró nǝ ɓabum wun kat.
Wu dum nǝ banɓoarnado aɓa tsǝkɓalǝu ma'wun; wu dum nǝ munyi aɓa tanni; wu do aɓa pak hiwi koya pwari.
Wu kǝ gau gìr ma'wun ace bwalia aɓwana mala Ɓakuli mǝnana à nda aɓa tǝle ka; wu do nǝ ɓealu mala ak abǝri.
Wu tsǝki aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ pa wun tanni ka bù; wu tsǝkia wia bù, ce wu suia ɗàng.
Wu pak banɓoarnado wunǝ aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ pak banɓoarnado ka; wu ɓua wunǝ aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ ɓua ka.

Wu do aɓa dotarǝu mala amǝ'eamrǝarǝu; wu kǝa twal ɓamur wun ɗàng; wu dum nǝ earce kpapi ɓamuru wunǝ aɓwana mǝnana acili aɓwana twali à pà kun ɓe kǝgìr raka. Wu kǝa twali kǝla wu kútì aɓwana nǝ sǝlǝe ɗàng.
Ce wu nyesǝî kǝ ɓwa ɓealɓikea ace ɓealɓikea ɗang. Wu pak gìr mǝnana nǝ̀ lǝmdǝì aɓwana kat pěmǝɓoarne ma'wun ngga.
Ɓǝ̀ nǝ̀ gandǝ pa ka, wu do aɓa dorǝpwala wunǝ aɓwana kat.
Wun amǝ'eambǝam mǝnana ǝn earkiyicea ka, wu kǝa pak mǝɓane a kun mǝɓane mǝnana à pakka wun ngga ɗàng. Wu nyinggi Ɓakuli mbwe tangnakusǝu aɓa ɓashi male. Acemǝnana Mǝtalabangŋo bang aɓa Malǝmce ama,
A kun mani, kǝla mana Malǝmce na ka,
Wu kǝa eari ɓealɓikea ɓǝ̀ limurǝm amur wun ɗàng, wu limurǝm amur ɓealɓikea nǝ pěmǝɓoarne.
